objective: Review 3 - Stage 2: Resend Email Integration & Risk-Based Notification System

acceptance_criteria.statement: Resend Edge Function and backend email integration with secure key handling
Risk threshold rules (0-24 Low, 25-51 Warning, 52-74 High, 75-100 Critical) and multi-channel notifications
Individual administrator email mapping, settings UI, and editable templates
Reliable delivery tracking, duplicate prevention, and clean production build
